AGRI.G8.CONSER.SOIL_CONSERVATION_MEASUR..mastery: The child names terracing (steps on a slope), contour farming, mulching, cover crops, planting trees and strip cropping, and says they slow water and wind so soil is not carried away. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Says how soil conservation measures are carried out: mark the contour (with an A-frame or line level), lay stone lines or trash lines along it, build soil bunds with the soil thrown uphill or downhill as designed, plant strips of crops or grass across the slope, grass a waterway to carry extra water safely, and repair after heavy rain; in the app the child picks the right step, order, tool, material or reason in new situations. The practical (carrying out soil conservation activities in the school) is marked by the teacher with the KICD rubric indicator; the app asks only the knowledge half. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

AGRI.G8.FOOD_P.POULTRY_REARING_IN_A_FOL..mastery: The child says a fold is a light movable pen that is moved to fresh ground, protects birds from predators and rain, spreads manure and keeps the birds clean. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Says how a fold is built: sized for the number of birds, a light frame of wood or reused materials so two people can move it, a roofed part for shelter and laying, a wire mesh run with no gaps, handles or wheels, and a door for feeding and cleaning; in the app the child picks the right step, order, tool, material or reason in new situations. The practical (constructing a poultry fold) is marked by the teacher with the KICD rubric indicator; the app asks only the knowledge half. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

Says how poultry are reared in a fold: moved to fresh ground every few days, fed and given clean water daily, feeders and waterers cleaned, droppings left on the ground as manure, protected from predators, rain and hot sun, and sick birds separated; in the app the child picks the right step, order, tool, material or reason in new situations. The practical (rearing poultry in a fold as a project) is marked by the teacher with the KICD rubric indicator; the app asks only the knowledge half. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.
